feature: RBPC Inquiry Idempotency and Retry Safety
summary: Hardened inquiry idempotency and retry safety in backend/routers/rbpc.py. Enforced identical payload idempotent replays returning original HTTP 202 Accepted with identical public reference and status tokens, conflict detection returning HTTP 409 RBPC_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT on differing parameters (experience, name, contact_value, party_size), and graceful handling of PostgreSQL unique constraint violations (IntegrityError on uq_rbpc_inquiries_idempotency) via rollback and re-fetch recovery.

idempotent_replay.behavior: Submitting identical inquiry with same idempotency_key returns identical public_ref and opaque_token with zero duplicate DB rows.
idempotent_replay.receipt_message: Yêu cầu đã được ghi nhận trước đó. Nhà cung cấp sẽ liên hệ xác nhận lịch trống trong vòng 24 giờ.

conflict_detection.error_message: Idempotency key has already been used with differing parameters.

concurrency_race_safety.exception_handling: IntegrityError caught at db.flush() / db.commit(), transaction rolled back, record re-fetched by idempotency_key, and evaluated for match (HTTP 202) or conflict (HTTP 409).
concurrency_race_safety.multi_thread_safety: Verified via real parallel thread pool against PostgreSQL database engine.

risks.mitigation: PostgreSQL unique constraint uq_rbpc_inquiries_idempotency acts as the definitive concurrency boundary; IntegrityError rollback-and-fetch ensures zero 500 errors and transparent 202 recovery or 409 rejection.

risks.area: Partial session state corruption on rollback
risks.mitigation: exp_id is captured as a scalar UUID prior to flush/commit, avoiding detached instance attribute expiration issues during db.rollback().
